top_left.description: A tiny Squamate head with one bright eye peeking out of a white, leathery egg buried in 'Chalky white' silt; a sense of wonder.

top_right.description: The Squamate perched on a 'Maroon' rock, its tongue catching a small 'Amber' colored ant; large expressive eyes showing focus.

bottom_left.description: The Squamate curled into a tight spiral inside a cool, 'Pale lavender' rock crack; soft moonlight filtering in.

bottom_right.description: The Squamate on a 'Dull green' mossy bank, standing high on its legs and looking at its own tail with a playful, 'confused' expression.
